decision.rationale: UBC explicitly partners with the Mastercard Foundation to provide university education opportunities to young people from Africa. The public homepage offers application information and scholar accounts, with no exclusively Okanagan scope. Scholarship opportunities are the host purpose; explicit scholar stories and contact assistance override that fallback.

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly features scholar profiles, first-person reflections and stories of program impact.
